prompt: Away from hydrothermal vents, most animals in the deep ocean ultimately depend for food on 'marine snow'. What is marine snow?

options.text: White mineral crystals that form on the seabed and are eaten directly
A steady fall of dead plankton, faecal pellets and other organic debris from the sunlit surface waters above
Frozen seawater that sinks when surface water gets very cold
Fine white sand stirred up from the continental shelves

explanation: With no sunlight for local photosynthesis, deep-sea communities largely run on organic matter produced in surface waters that dies or is egested and slowly sinks as marine snow.
